reflection.en: The Hong Kong government's sharp response to the US congressional commission highlights the tension between national security concerns and international scrutiny. Proverbs 29:2 reminds us that the stability and well-being of a populace are tied to the character and actions of its rulers, urging leaders to govern with justice and integrity.
reflection.zh: 香港政府对美国国会委员会的严厉回应，凸显了国家安全关切与国际监督之间的紧张关系。箴言29:2提醒我们，民众的稳定与福祉与统治者的品格和行为息息相关，敦促领导者以公正和诚信来治理。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: Hong Kong to legislate against persistent child sexual abuse and ‘cyberflashing’
title.zh: 香港将立法打击持续的儿童性虐待和“网络闪照”

summary.en: Hong Kong authorities announced plans to introduce legislation against persistent child sexual abuse and the non-consensual online sharing of explicit images. This move follows public consultation and aims to address serious harms to children and individuals.
summary.zh: 香港当局宣布计划立法，打击持续的儿童性虐待以及未经同意在网上分享露骨图像的行为。此举是在公众咨询之后提出的，旨在解决对儿童和个人造成的严重伤害。

body.en: Hong Kong authorities have said they will legislate against persistent sexual abuse of children and the act of sending images of genitals to others online without consent after consulting the public. In a consultation report published on Thursday, the Security Bureau stated that with the city’s two professional legal associations expressing broad support for a dedicated law targeting persistent child sexual abuse, the government would include the crime in an amendment bill overhauling sex...
body.zh: 香港当局表示，在征求公众意见后，他们将立法禁止持续性虐待儿童以及未经同意在网上向他人发送生殖器图像的行为。在周四发布的一份咨询报告中，安全局表示，随着该市的两个专业法律协会对针对持续存在的儿童性虐待的专门法律表示广泛支持，政府将把这一罪行纳入一项全面改革性虐待的修正案中……

reflection.en: The Hong Kong Security Bureau's commitment to legislating against child sexual abuse and "cyberflashing" reflects a crucial step in protecting the vulnerable. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute." This legislative action embodies that principle by creating legal safeguards...
reflection.zh: 香港保安局承诺立法打击儿童性虐待和“网络闪照”，这体现了保护弱势群体的重要一步。《箴言》31:8-9 呼吁我们“要为不能言语的开口，为一切孤苦人伸冤”。这项立法行动通过为儿童和遭受此类虐待的其他人创建法律保障，体现了这一原则。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: 100 start-ups joining Hong Kong’s flagship tech hub to get top mentors
title.zh: 100家初创公司加入香港旗舰科技中心接受顶尖导师指导

summary.en: Approximately 100 start-ups have been selected to join Hong Kong's flagship innovation and technology park. These companies will participate in mentorship programs lasting five to eight years, supported by industry leaders. The selection process involved several months of screening, according to Vincent Ma, CEO of...
summary.zh: 约有100家初创公司被选中加入香港的旗舰创新及科技园。据Loop Hong Kong Park Company首席执行官Vincent Ma透露，这些公司将接受为期五至八年的导师计划，并获得行业领袖的支持。甄选过程经过了数月的严格筛选。

body.en: Around 100 start-ups selected to join Hong Kong’s flagship border tech hub will undergo mentorship programmes ranging from five to eight years, backed by industry heavyweights, the operator has revealed. Vincent Ma, CEO of Loop Hong Kong Park Company, said in an interview on Thursday that the start-ups were chosen to join the Hong Kong-Shenzhen Innovation and Technology Park (HSITP) following a months-long screening process. “We have chosen 100 start-ups to enter our park soon following a few...
body.zh: 该运营商透露，被选中加入香港旗舰边境科技中心的约 100 家初创企业将接受为期五年至八年的指导计划，并得到行业重量级人物的支持。路套香港园区公司首席执行官马永康周四在接受采访时表示，经过长达数月的筛选过程，这些初创企业被选入港深创新及科技园（HSITP）。 “我们选择了 100 家初创企业入驻我们的园区，不久之后...

reflection.en: This initiative in Hong Kong aims to nurture 100 start-ups through extensive mentorship, offering them a significant runway for growth. It reflects a commitment to fostering innovation and providing seasoned guidance. As these ventures embark on their journey, the ancient wisdom to commit their work to Yahweh, trusting that their plans will succeed through...
reflection.zh: 香港这项计划旨在通过广泛的导师指导来培育100家初创公司，为它们的成长提供重要的支持。这体现了对促进创新和提供经验丰富指导的承诺。当这些企业踏上征程之际，那句古老的智慧——将你的事交托给雅伟，使你所谋定的得以成就——为它们的努力提供了深刻的视角。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: 'AI City Brain' is for emergency services: govt
title.zh: “智慧城市”用于紧急服务：政府

summary.en: Hong Kong's government announced that a new integrated city management system utilizing artificial intelligence, dubbed 'AI City Brain,' will complete its initial development phase by early 2028 and mature over the next six to nine years. Officials emphasized that the system is intended for improving daily city...
summary.zh: 香港政府周四表示，一个内置人工智能的新型综合城市管理系统将于2028年第一季度完成第一阶段开发，而整个系统则需要六到九年才能成熟。官员们强调，“智慧城市大脑”将不会用于犯罪侦查或监控目的，其目的是通过“大数据分析”整合相关大数据并向政府部门提供实时信息，以改善日常城市管理和应急响应。

body.en: The government said on Thursday that a new integrated city management system with built-in artificial intelligence will complete the first phase of development by the first quarter of 2028, while the full system will take six to nine years to mature. Officials stressed "AI City Brain" will not be used for crime-detection or surveillance purposes, saying the aim is to improve day-to-day city management and emergency response. Under the plan announced in Wednesday's Policy Address, "AI City Brain" would "link up and consolidate relevant big data" and feed real-time information to government departments through "big data analytics". Chief Secretary Eric Chan, who will lead a task force to take forward the initiative, said HK$200 million has been earmarked for the first phase of the system's buildout. "Total budget is not yet... we do not have any estimation now, because you know that after six to nine years, I really don't know how fast or how cheap the IT is, maybe the prices could go down quickly," he said. He added that by the third quarter of 2028, the system is expected to connect to the 1823 Contact Centre and the databases of emergency services. "I want to reiterate that the "[AI] City Brain" system is not for crime detection. It is for city management. This is a very important principle," he said. "These computer systems, they're now operating separately, independently, I would say, in different departments. But I think we want to, we want them to integrate into a single system, and adding the function of AI, then we can predict any disasters or any accidents from happening. This is a very, very important purpose." At the same press conference, Secretary for Security Chris Tang said the new Huanggang port is expected to start operating by the fourth quarter of this year. He said more than 100 system trials, stress tests and drills have been conducted so far, helping officials to rectify issues such as Wi-Fi connectivity and slippery driveways at the public transport interchange. Edited by Raymond Yeung
body.zh: 政府周四表示，内置人工智能的新型综合城市管理系统将于 2028 年第一季度完成第一阶段开发，而整个系统需要六到九年的时间才能成熟。官员们强调，“人工智能城市大脑”不会用于犯罪侦查或监视目的，称其目的是改善日常城市管理和应急响应。根据周三施政报告公布的计划，“人工智能城市大脑”将“连接和整合相关大数据”，并通过“大数据分析”向政府部门提供实时信息。政务司司长陈家祥将率领一个专责小组推进这项计划，他表示已预留 2 亿港元用于该系统第一阶段的建设。 “总预算还没有……我们现在没有任何估计，因为你知道，六到九年后，我真的不知道IT的速度有多快或有多便宜，也许价格会很快下降，”他说。他补充说，到2028年第三季度，该系统预计将连接到1823联络中心和紧急服务数据库。 “我想重申，‘人工智能城市大脑’系统不是为了犯罪侦查，而是为了城市管理。这是一个非常重要的原则，”他说。 “这些计算机系统，我想说，它们现在在不同的部门单独、独立地运行。但我认为我们希望，我们希望它们集成到一个系统中，并添加人工智能的功能，然后我们可以预测任何灾难或任何事故的发生。这是一个非常非常重要的目的。”在同一场新闻发布会上，保安局局长唐英年表示，新皇岗口岸预计将于今年第四季度投入运营。他说，到目前为止，已经进行了100多次系统试验、压力测试和演习，帮助官员纠正公共交通交汇处的Wi-Fi连接和车道湿滑等问题。杨雷蒙编辑

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of technology, as seen in Hong Kong's 'AI City Brain' project, reflects a world where knowledge and data processing are accelerating. Daniel 12:4 speaks of knowledge increasing in the "time of the end," a prophecy that resonates with our current era of unprecedented technological growth. As we develop powerful tools like AI, may we...
reflection.zh: 香港“智慧城市大脑”项目所展现的技术飞速发展，反映了一个知识和数据处理日益加速的世界。但以理书12:4预言“末期”知识将增长，这与我们当前前所未有的技术增长时代产生了共鸣。当我们开发人工智能等强大工具时，愿我们寻求智慧，将其用于共同利益，确保它们服务于人类而非控制人类。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Evening News on TV32 - Sep 17
title.zh: 行政长官周四就最新政策蓝图回答议员及公众提问

summary.en: The Chief Executive will address questions from lawmakers and the public regarding his latest policy blueprints on Thursday.
summary.zh: 行政长官将于周四就其最新政策蓝图回答议员及公众的提问。

reflection.en: As leaders present their visions and plans, the call to 'act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with your God' echoes through the halls of governance. May those in power seek wisdom not just for effective policy, but for policies that reflect divine justice and compassion for all citizens.
reflection.zh: 当领导者提出他们的愿景和计划时，‘行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心与你的雅伟同行’的呼召在治理的殿堂中回响。愿掌权者不仅寻求有效的政策，更寻求能反映雅伟的公义和对所有公民的怜悯的政策。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Innovation spending boost by 2030 'aggressive target'
title.zh: 2030年创新支出翻倍目标‘雄心勃勃’

summary.en: Hong Kong's Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry, Sun Dong, has stated that the government aims to nearly double its spending on innovation within the next five years. This initiative, part of the city's first five-year blueprint, seeks to increase domestic innovation expenditure from 1.63% of GDP in 2024...
summary.zh: 创新、科技及工业局局长孙东表示，政府的目标是在未来五年内将创新方面的支出几乎翻倍。这是香港首份五年规划的一部分，旨在将本地创新活动支出从2024年的占本地生产总值的1.63%提高到2030年的3%。孙形容这是一个‘雄心勃勃的目标’，旨在推动政府和行业的投资。

body.en: Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong said he hopes the government's goal of almost doubling spending on innovation in the coming five years will attract more funds to the city. According to Hong Kong's inaugural five-year blueprint, the SAR will strive to raise domestic expenditure on innovation activities to 3 percent of GDP by 2030 from 1.63 percent in 2024. "This is a relatively aggressive target," Sun told reporters. "We want to use this indicator to measure as well as to push for more investments on these innovation activities – not only from government side, but also mainly from the industry. "In Hong Kong, as we are pressing ahead with the new industrialisation development, we hope in the coming five years more investment from industry will go to the innovation activities, including now we also encourage many enterprises to establish R&D centres and so on." Sun said the target would cover not only expenditure on basic applied research commonly seen in universities, but also activities by enterprises such as product design, software development and pilot production. The government also expects a 10 percent increase in average annual expenditure in the next five years. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 创新科技及工业局局长孙东表示，他希望政府在未来五年将创新支出增加近一倍的目标将吸引更多资金流入香港。根据香港首个五年蓝图，香港特区将力争到2030年将国内创新活动支出占GDP的比例从2024年的1.63%提高到3%。“这是一个相对激进的目标，”孙告诉记者。 “我们希望通过这个指标来衡量，并推动对这些创新活动的更多投资——不仅是政府方面，而且主要是来自工业界。在香港，随着我们正在推进新型工业化发展，我们希望未来五年工业界能有更多的投资投向创新活动，包括现在我们也鼓励很多企业建立研发中心等等。”孙说，这个目标不仅包括大学里常见的基础应用研究的支出，还包括企业的活动，例如产品设计、软件等。政府还预计未来五年的年均支出将增加 10%（Edmond Fong 编辑）。

reflection.en: Hong Kong is setting an ambitious target to significantly increase its investment in innovation and technology. This drive for progress and development reflects a human desire to build and create, seeking a better future. As plans are made and resources are allocated, may the efforts be guided by wisdom and a commitment to excellence, trusting that the...
reflection.zh: 香港设定了一个雄心勃勃的目标，旨在大幅增加对创新和技术的投资。这种对进步和发展的追求反映了人类建设和创造、寻求更美好未来的愿望。在制定计划和分配资源时，愿这些努力都能得到智慧的指引和卓越的承诺，并信靠最终的成果都在雅伟的手中。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: ‘No doubt’ of climate change role in deadly China-Nepal flood: scientists
title.zh: 科学家：气候变化是导致中尼边境洪灾的“核心因素”

summary.en: Scientists have identified climate change as a primary factor in a recent glacial mountain collapse on the China-Nepal border, which resulted in over 1,400 deaths and left 6,600 missing. The disaster was characterized as a 'compound crisis' involving long-term warming, glacier retreat, permafrost thaw, and geological...
summary.zh: 科学家们指出，气候变化是近期中尼边境冰川山体崩塌的主要因素，此次灾难已导致超过1400人死亡，另有6600人失踪。该事件被描述为一场“复合危机”，涉及长期变暖、冰川退缩、永久冻土融化和地质不稳定，而非单一的极端天气事件。

body.en: Climate change was a core factor in last month’s deadly glacial mountain collapse on the China-Nepal border that killed more than 1,400 people and left at least 6,600 missing, scientists said Thursday. A man looks at the remains in the aftermath of flash floods at Trishuli in Nepal’s Nuwakot district on September 7, 2026. Photo: Pedro Pardo/AFP. However, scientists from the World Weather Attribution (WWA) group said, the disaster was not caused by a single extreme weather event, rather a “compound crisis” shaped by long-term warming, glacier retreat, permafrost thaw and geological instability. “Relentless warming has lifted the altitude of the freezing threshold on the high Himalaya, exposing ice and permafrost deep in the bedrock to higher and longer thaw temperatures, weakening mountain slopes,” a WWA report said. A massive section of rock and glacier broke away from Langtang Lirung mountain on August 26, triggering a huge flood of water, ice and debris that swept downstream, destroying communities and infrastructure. ‘Irreversible shifts’ Report co-author Walter Immerzeel, a mountain hydrologist at Utrecht University, said the region was undergoing “fundamental, irreversible shifts”, with glacier retreat and permafrost degradation undermining mountain stability. “We conclude that this was a geologically vulnerable slope, potentially weakened by the 2015 earthquake, but it was destabilised further by glacier retreat and permafrost fall,” Immerzeel told reporters. Nepal, a largely rural nation of 30 million people, contributes a fraction of global greenhouse gas emissions compared to industrialised nations. The study found that July and August 2026 were the warmest months locally recorded, while heavy snowfall in late 2025 contributed to increased meltwater before the collapse. A magnitude 7.8 earthquake in Nepal in 2015 may have further weakened the slope, although its precise role remains uncertain, the report said. Workers repair a section of road leading to Gyirong Port on August 28, 2026, which was damaged after a mudslide two days earlier, in Gyirong County. Photo: CNS/AFP. Last month’s disaster has also raised concerns about the limits of adaptation. Prime Minister Balendra Shah will take his first foreign trip as Nepal’s leader to address the UN General Assembly on the urgent issue next week. Nepal estimates the reconstruction bill after deadly floods sparked by a glacial mountain collapse last month will amount to $4.78 billion. ‘No doubt’ “There is no doubt that climate change is one of the drivers, and therefore obviously it needs to be discussed in the context of loss and damage,” Friederike Otto, a professor of climate science at...
body.zh: 科学家周四表示，气候变化是上个月中尼边境致命冰川山崩塌的核心因素，这场崩塌造成 1,400 多人死亡，至少 6,600 人失踪。 2026 年 9 月 7 日，尼泊尔努瓦科特地区特里苏里，一名男子正在查看山洪暴发后的遗骸。照片：Pedro Pardo/法新社。然而，世界天气归因组织（WWA）的科学家表示，这场灾难并不是单一的极端天气事件造成的，而是由长期变暖、冰川退缩、永久冻土融化和地质不稳定所形成的“复合危机”。世界气象组织的一份报告称：“持续的变暖提高了喜马拉雅山高处的冰冻阈值，使基岩深处的冰和永久冻土暴露在更高和更长时间的解冻温度下，削弱了山坡。” 8 月 26 日，一大片岩石和冰川从 Langtang Lirung 山脱落，引发洪水、冰和碎片席卷下游，摧毁了社区和基础设施。 “不可逆转的变化”报告的合著者、乌得勒支大学山区水文学家沃尔特·伊默泽尔表示，该地区正在经历“根本性的、不可逆转的变化”，冰川退缩和永久冻土退化破坏了山区的稳定性。伊默泽尔告诉记者：“我们的结论是，这是一个地质脆弱的斜坡，可能会因 2015 年地震而变得脆弱，但冰川退缩和永久冻土层塌陷进一步破坏了它的稳定性。”尼泊尔是一个拥有 3000 万人口、以农村为主的国家，与工业化国家相比，其温室气体排放量仅占全球温室气体排放量的一小部分。研究发现，2026年7月和8月是当地有记录以来最温暖的月份，而2025年末的大雪导致崩塌前融水增加。报告称，2015 年尼泊尔发生的 7.8 级地震可能进一步削弱了斜坡，但其确切作用仍不确定。 2026 年 8 月 28 日，工人们正在修复吉隆县通往吉隆口岸的一段道路，该道路因两天前的泥石流而受损。照片：CNS/法新社。上个月的灾难也引发了人们对适应局限性的担忧。巴伦德拉·沙阿总理将于下周作为尼泊尔领导人首次出访，在联合国大会上就这一紧迫问题发表讲话。尼泊尔估计上个月冰川山崩塌引发致命洪水后的重建费用将达到 47.8 亿美元。 “毫无疑问”“毫无疑问，气候变化是驱动因素之一，因此显然需要在损失和损害的背景下进行讨论，”弗里德里克·奥托（Friederike Otto），气候科学教授。

reflection.en: The earth itself groans, bearing the weight of human impact and systemic disruption. As scientists link this devastating flood to climate change, we see a world out of balance, a consequence of long-term warming and environmental instability. May we recognize our interconnectedness with creation and seek wisdom to live as faithful stewards.
reflection.zh: 大地本身也在呻吟，承受着人类活动和系统性破坏的重负。当科学家们将这场毁灭性的洪水与气候变化联系起来时，我们看到了一个失衡的世界，这是长期变暖和环境不稳定的后果。愿我们认识到与受造界的相互联系，并寻求智慧，作为忠实的管家生活。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Man jailed 4 weeks for grabbing passerby by the neck and attempting to kiss her
title.zh: 男子因非礼罪被判监禁四周

summary.en: A 29-year-old man in Hong Kong has been sentenced to four weeks in prison for indecent assault after pleading guilty to grabbing a female passerby by the neck and attempting to kiss her. The incident occurred in the early hours of Tuesday in Shau Kei Wan.
summary.zh: 一名29岁的香港男子因非礼罪被判处四周监禁。他承认在周二凌晨于筲箕湾袭击一名路过的女子，抓住她的脖子并试图亲吻她。

body.en: A Hong Kong man accused of grabbing the neck of a female passerby and attempting to kiss her has been sentenced to four weeks in prison for indecent assault. Eastern Law Courts Building. Photo: Almond Li/HKFP. Fung Ho-yin, 29, appeared at the Eastern Magistrates’ Courts on Wednesday, The Witness reported . He pleaded guilty to a charge of indecent assault stemming from an incident in the early hours of Tuesday in Shau Kei Wan. Fung was sitting on a bench in a park on Nam On Street at around 1am that day when a woman – known to the court as X – walked past him, according to the prosecution. Fung first attempted to take a photo of X. He then stood up and followed her, and wrapped his left arm around X’s neck while using his other arm to touch her chest. He also tried to kiss her, the prosecution said. X managed to escape and screamed for help. Nam On Street Sitting-out Area in Shau Kei Wan. Photo: Wikicommons. She got the attention of a man inside a nearby gym, who ran out and helped her. X then called the police. Officers arrived at the scene and arrested Fung, who admitted under police caution that he had committed the offence out of impulse, The Witness reported. He told police he was attracted to X’s miniskirt and hoped to get close to and speak with her. But X noticed him approach and told him to go away, he said. See also: Hong Kong court acquits gov’t statistician who followed, photographed girl during school open day Handing down the sentence, Magistrate Kestrel Lam said the incident occurred in the quiet of the night, and that the consequences would have been hard to predict if nobody had come forward. He said that even though Fung had no criminal record, this was a serious case that warranted imprisonment, Ming Pao reported . Indecent assault is punishable by up to 10 years’ imprisonment, although jail terms in magistrates’ courts are capped at two years for a single offence.
body.zh: 一名香港男子被控抓住一名女性路人的脖子并试图亲吻她，因猥亵罪被判处四个星期监禁。东区法院大楼。照片：Almond Li/HKFP。据《见证人》报道，29 岁的冯浩然周三在东区裁判法院出庭。他承认因周二凌晨在筲箕湾发生的一起事件而被控猥亵罪。检方称，当天凌晨 1 点左右，冯正坐在南安街一个公园的长凳上，一名女子（法庭称 X）从他身边走过。冯先尝试给X拍照，然后起身跟随X，左臂搂住X的脖子，另一只手抚摸X的胸部。检方称，他还试图亲吻她。 X成功逃脱并大声呼救。筲箕湾南安街休憩处。照片：维基共享资源。她引起了附近健身房内一名男子的注意，后者跑出去帮助了她。 X随后报了警。据《见证人》报道，警察赶到现场并逮捕了冯，冯在警方的警告下承认自己是出于冲动而犯罪。他告诉警方，他被X的迷你裙所吸引，希望能接近她并与她交谈。但 X 注意到他走近并告诉他走开，他说。另请参阅：香港法院宣判一名政府统计员无罪，该统计员在学校开放日期间跟踪并拍摄了一名女孩。 裁判官林凯斯特在宣判时表示，这起事件发生在深夜，如果没有人挺身而出，后果将难以预测。据《明报》报道，他表示，尽管冯没有犯罪记录，但案情严重，应入狱。猥亵罪最高可判处 10 年监禁，但治安法院对单次犯罪的刑期上限为两年。

reflection.en: This incident highlights the vulnerability of individuals in public spaces and the violation of personal boundaries. The legal system has responded with a sentence, but the deeper wound of assault and the fear it instills remain. We are called to defend the oppressed and seek justice, ensuring that such violations are not overlooked and that victims find...
reflection.zh: 这起事件凸显了公众场所个体所面临的脆弱性以及个人界限被侵犯的严重性。法律系统已作出判决，但袭击造成的创伤和由此产生的恐惧依然存在。我们蒙召要为受欺压者辩护，寻求公义，确保此类侵犯行为不被忽视，并让受害者找到支持和安全。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Tiananmen Square vigil organisers jailed for seven years in Hong Kong
title.zh: 香港国安法下，支联会前正副主席煽动颠覆罪成判囚七年

summary.en: Hong Kong activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan have been sentenced to seven years in prison after being found guilty of inciting subversion under the city's national security law for their roles in organizing an annual vigil commemorating the Tiananmen Square massacre.
summary.zh: 香港活动人士周庭栋和李卓人因在组织纪念天安门事件的年度集会中煽动颠覆国家政权，根据香港国安法被判处七年监禁。

body.en: Pro-democracy activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan were found guilty of ‘incitement to subversion’ in controversial national security case Two pro-democracy activists who were put on trial for organising an annual Tiananmen Square massacre vigil in Hong Kong have been sentenced to seven years in jail, in one of the city’s most significant national security cases. Chow Hang-tung, 41 and Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, were found guilty in August of incitement to subversion . The court found they had “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 民主活动人士周恒东和李卓人在有争议的国家安全案件中被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。两名因在香港组织一年一度的天安门广场大屠杀守夜活动而受审的民主活动人士被判处七年监禁，这是香港最重大的国家安全案件之一。 41 岁的周恒东和 69 岁的李卓人于 8 月被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。法院认为，他们“煽动他人以非法手段组织、策划、实施或者参与颠覆国家政权的行为”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The sentencing of Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan highlights a profound tension between civic duty and conscience. Their conviction for organizing a Tiananmen Square vigil raises questions about the limits of free expression and assembly when they are perceived to challenge state power. The principle of obeying God over human authorities, even when it...
reflection.zh: 周庭栋和李卓人的判刑凸显了公民责任与良知之间的深刻张力。他们因组织天安门事件悼念集会被定罪，引发了关于言论和集会自由界限的疑问，尤其是在这些自由被视为挑战国家权力之时。即使面临世俗的惩罚，也要优先顺服雅伟而非人间的命令，这一原则在这样的处境中引起了深刻共鸣。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Wall Street Journal publisher convicted in Hong Kong of deterring reporter from union role
title.zh: 《华尔街日报》出版商在香港被判犯有阻止记者担任工会职务的罪名

summary.en: Dow Jones, the publisher of The Wall Street Journal, has been convicted in a Hong Kong court of one count of deterring reporter Selina Cheng from taking up a role at the Hong Kong Journalist Association. The case raised concerns about press freedom in the city, as Cheng was dismissed weeks after her appointment as...
summary.zh: 《华尔街日报》的出版商道琼斯公司在香港一家法院被判犯有一项阻止记者郑丽莎担任香港记者协会职务的罪名。此案引发了对该市新闻自由的担忧，郑女士在2024年被任命为香港记协主席数周后被公司以重组为由解雇。

body.en: Dow Jones convicted of one count of deterring Selina Cheng from role at Hong Kong Journalist Association but cleared of second charge A Hong Kong court has convicted the publisher of the Wall Street Journal of deterring a reporter from taking up a trade union role, in a case that raised concerns about press freedom in the city. The newspaper dismissed Selina Cheng just weeks after she was appointed chair of the Hong Kong Journalist Association (HKJA) in 2024. She was told at the time her termination was officially due to restructuring. Continue reading...
body.zh: 道琼斯因一项阻止郑秀玲在香港记者协会任职的罪名被定罪，但第二项指控被洗清。香港一家法院判定《华尔街日报》出版商阻止一名记者担任工会职务的罪名成立，此案引起了人们对香港新闻自由的担忧。该报在 2024 年被任命为香港记者协会 (HKJA) 主席几周后解雇了郑嘉颖。当时她被告知，她的解雇正式是由于重组。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of Dow Jones in Hong Kong for deterring a reporter from union activity underscores a troubling trend where corporate actions can stifle worker advocacy. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly and loving mercy, even in the face of corporate restructuring or perceived inconvenience. May we pray for leaders...
reflection.zh: 道琼斯公司在香港被判阻止记者参与工会活动，这凸显了一个令人担忧的趋势：企业行为可能扼杀工人维权。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义在于秉行公义，喜爱怜悯，即使面对企业重组或所谓的“不便”。愿我们为媒体和商业界的领导者祈祷，愿他们坚守这些原则，确保追求利润不会掩盖员工的基本权利和尊严。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
title.zh: 自然科学

strap.en: Discoveries in nature, climate, health, and the wider cosmos.
strap.zh: 自然、气候、健康与宇宙万象的新发现。

title.en: Portable metasurface biosensor turns molecular signals into images, bypassing spectrometers
title.zh: 便携式超表面生物传感器将分子信号转化为图像，绕过光谱仪

summary.en: What if signs of disease could be detected using nothing more than a tiny chip that fits in the palm of your hand and a camera, without ever visiting a hospital? A scene that once seemed possible only in science fiction has now moved one step closer to reality.
summary.zh: 如果仅凭一个可以放在手掌中的微型芯片和一台相机就能检测到疾病的迹象，而无需去医院，那会怎么样？曾经似乎只有科幻小说中才可能出现的场景，现在又向前迈进了一步。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

What if signs of disease could be detected using nothing more than a tiny chip that fits in the palm of your hand and a camera, without ever visiting a hospital? A scene that once seemed possible only in science fiction has now moved one step closer to reality.

A research team led by Professor Junsuk Rho of the Departments of Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, and the Graduate School of Convergence Science and Technology at POSTECH, together with Dr. Hongyoon Kim of the Department of Mechanical Engineering and Heechang Yun and Sebin Jeong of the Department of Chemical Engineering, has developed a metasurface biosensor capable of precisely detecting biomolecules through imaging without the need for an expensive spectrometer.

The research was conducted in collaboration with Professor Hyomin Lee's group in the Department of Chemical Engineering at POSTECH and Professor Yong-Sang Ryu's group in the Department of Biomedical Engineering at Korea University. The study was published in Nature Communications .

Biosensors are essential tools in health care, with applications ranging from disease diagnosis and infectious disease testing to cancer biomarker detection and genetic analysis. Among them, optical biosensors offer a particularly important advantage. They can directly detect biomolecules without fluorescent labels by measuring subtle optical changes that occur when target molecules bind to the sensor surface.

The challenge, however, has been the size and complexity of conventional systems. Detecting such minute optical changes typically requires a high-resolution spectrometer together with a broadband light source. Because these instruments are bulky and expensive, it has been difficult to bring high-performance optical biosensing beyond laboratories and hospitals.

The POSTECH-led team approached the problem from a different perspective. Instead of measuring a spectrum with a spectrometer, they designed the sensor to convert spectral information into spatial information that can be directly read through imaging.

At the heart of the technology is a specially engineered continuous geometric-gradient metasurface. The nanoscale structures that make up the metasurface gradually change in geometry along one direction of the chip, causing different positions to respond to different wavelengths of light.

Just as the keys of a piano produce different notes depending on their position, different locations on the metasurface resonate at different wavelengths.

When the metasurface is illuminated with a compact single-wavelength laser, a dark...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 如果只用手掌上的微型芯片和相机就能检测到疾病迹象，而无需去医院，结果会怎样呢？曾经只存在于科幻小说中的场景现在已经离现实更近了一步。 由浦项科技大学机械工程系、化学工程系、电气工程系和融合科学与技术研究生院的 Junsuk Rho 教授领导的研究小组，与机械工程系的 Hongyoon Kim 博士以及化学工程系的 Heechang Yun 和 Sebin Jeong 一起，开发了一种超表面生物传感器，能够通过成像精确检测生物分子，而不需要昂贵的光谱仪。 该研究是与浦项科技大学化学工程系的 Hyomin Lee 教授团队和高丽大学生物医学工程系的 Yong-Sang Ryu 教授团队合作进行的。该研究发表在《自然通讯》上。 生物传感器是医疗保健领域的重要工具，其应用范围从疾病诊断和传染病检测到癌症生物标志物检测和遗传分析。其中，光学生物传感器具有尤为重要的优势。它们可以通过测量目标分子与传感器表面结合时发生的细微光学变化来直接检测生物分子，无需荧光标记。 然而，挑战在于传统系统的规模和复杂性。检测如此微小的光学变化通常需要高分辨率光谱仪和宽带光源。由于这些仪器体积庞大且昂贵，因此很难将高性能光学生物传感带到实验室和医院之外。 浦项科技大学领导的团队从不同的角度解决了这个问题。他们设计的传感器不是用光谱仪测量光谱，而是将光谱信息转换为可以通过成像直接读取的空间信息。 该技术的核心是专门设计的连续几何梯度超表面。构成超表面的纳米级结构沿着芯片的一个方向逐渐改变几何形状，导致不同的位置响应不同波长的光。 正如钢琴的琴键根据其位置产生不同的音符一样，超表面上的不同位置会以不同的波长产生共振。 当用紧凑型单波长激光照射超表面时，会产生暗...

reflection.en: This new biosensor technology, capable of transforming molecular signals into visual images, offers a glimpse into the intricate design of life. It reminds us that even the smallest components of our world hold profound information, waiting to be uncovered through careful observation and ingenuity. The ability to 'see' disease at its molecular level...
reflection.zh: 这项新的生物传感器技术能够将分子信号转化为视觉图像，让我们得以一窥生命精妙的设计。它提醒我们，即使是我们世界中最小的组成部分也蕴含着深刻的信息，等待着通过细致的观察和创造力被揭示出来。能够从分子层面“看见”疾病，反映了一个更深层的真理：受造的秩序及其复杂性，可以教会我们许多关于其创造者的知识。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Tons of fishing gear and plastic are washing up on Seychelles beaches. We tracked where it was coming from
title.zh: 塞舌尔海滩上冲上来大量渔具和塑料。我们追踪了它们的来源

summary.en: Vast quantities of plastic and fishing gear are washing up along the shores of the Seychelles, destroying fragile ecosystems and causing significant economic problems.
summary.zh: 大量的塑料和渔具正冲刷着塞舌尔的海岸线，破坏着脆弱的生态系统，并造成严重的经济问题。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Vast quantities of plastic and fishing gear are washing up along the shores of the Seychelles, destroying fragile ecosystems and causing significant economic problems.

Aldabra Atoll, a UNESCO World Heritage Site in this archipelago nation of 115 islands, is estimated to have accumulated more than 500 tons of plastic on its shores alone. Most of this plastic debris continues to pile up along its beaches today. It was estimated that removing it would cost approximately US$4.68 million (£3.46 million) and would require 18,000 hours of labor.

Small island developing states are particularly vulnerable to plastic debris on their beaches. It can damage tourism and fishing in these coastal communities , which are essential to their economies. Cleanup costs can be prohibitive.

Fish and other marine life can also be killed by becoming entangled in or ingesting plastic debris.

It is impossible to tackle this growing problem without knowing where this pollution is coming from and who is responsible. We investigated this in our recent study using computer simulations and observations, focusing on pollution in the western Indian Ocean from fisheries and shipping.

We found that most pollution probably comes from vessels in or near the Seychelles' own waters. This challenges the assumption from previous work that island plastic mainly drifts in from distant shores .

We know fishing vessels lose nets and gear , and shipping vessels illegally discard plastic and other items. But to work out which vessels are responsible and where their debris ends up, we needed to know which ships and fishing boats operate near the Seychelles.

To do this, we used satellite tracking data from fishing and shipping vessels over five years, from 2018 to 2022, to estimate activity across the region. Using this map, we simulated the drift of billions of virtual pollution fragments and followed where they ended up.

From this, we built a map showing how likely a given vessel location is to pose a risk to the Seychelles' islands. We did this separately for fishing and shipping.

Our research shows, based on previous fishing activity, that most fishing gear swept up on the beaches of the Seychelles comes from fishing within its own exclusive economic zone. These are the waters extending 200 nautical miles (370 km, 230 miles) offshore, over which a state has exclusive control over marine resources, including fisheries.

These waters are full of tuna, and the Seychelles' economy leans heavily on industrial fishing, both as an employer and as a large source of foreign currency .

Discover the latest in...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 大量塑料和渔具被冲上塞舌尔海岸，破坏了脆弱的生态系统并造成严重的经济问题。 阿尔达布拉环礁是这个由 115 个岛屿组成的群岛国家，被联合国教科文组织列为世界遗产，据估计，仅其海岸就积累了超过 500 吨塑料。如今，大部分塑料碎片仍在海滩上堆积。据估计，拆除它将花费约 468 万美元（346 万英镑），并需要 18,000 小时的劳动力。 小岛屿发展中国家特别容易受到海滩上塑料碎片的影响。它可能会损害这些沿海社区的旅游业和渔业，而这对其经济至关重要。清理费用可能令人望而却步。 鱼类和其他海洋生物也可能因被塑料碎片缠住或摄入而死亡。 如果不知道污染从何而来以及责任人是谁，就不可能解决这个日益严重的问题。我们在最近的研究中利用计算机模拟和观察对此进行了调查，重点关注西印度洋渔业和航运造成的污染。 我们发现大部分污染可能来自塞舌尔本国水域内或附近的船只。这挑战了先前研究中的假设，即岛屿塑料主要从遥远的海岸漂流进来。 我们知道渔船丢失渔网和渔具，运输船只非法丢弃塑料和其他物品。但为了确定哪些船只对此负责以及其残骸最终去了哪里，我们需要知道哪些船只和渔船在塞舌尔附近作业。 为此，我们使用 2018 年至 2022 年五年间渔船和运输船只的卫星跟踪数据来估计该地区的活动。使用这张地图，我们模拟了数十亿个虚拟污染碎片的漂移，并追踪它们最终的去向。 据此，我们制作了一张地图，显示给定船只位置对塞舌尔群岛构成风险的可能性有多大。我们分别为捕鱼和航运进行了这项工作。 我们的研究表明，根据以往的捕捞活动，塞舌尔海滩上被卷走的大多数渔具来自其专属经济区内的捕捞。这些水域是离岸 200 海里（370 公里、230 英里）的水域，国家对其海洋资源（包括渔业）拥有专属控制权。 这些水域盛产金枪鱼，塞舌尔的经济严重依赖工业化捕捞，既是雇主，又是外汇的重要来源。 发现最新的...

reflection.en: The shores of the Seychelles are choked with plastic debris, a stark reminder that our actions have far-reaching consequences for the natural world. The Psalmist reminds us that the Earth is Yahweh's and all that is in it. This vast accumulation of waste, originating from distant sources, calls us to a deeper sense of stewardship over the creation entrusted...
reflection.zh: 塞舌尔的海岸线被塑料垃圾所困扰，这 stark 地提醒我们，我们的行为对自然世界会产生深远的影响。诗人提醒我们，地和其中万物都属于雅伟。这些来自遥远源头的巨量垃圾堆积，呼唤我们对托付给我们的受造物承担更深层的管理责任。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Two spike 'keys' work together to let SARS-CoV-2 enter cells, study reveals
title.zh: 两把刺突“钥匙”协同作用，让SARS-CoV-2进入细胞，研究揭示

summary.en: A new study by ITQB NOVA researchers has discovered that the SARS-CoV-2 virus uses two distinct 'keys' on its spike protein, working in tandem, to fuse with and enter host cells. These fusion peptides act as molecular mechanisms enabling the virus's cellular entry.
summary.zh: ITQB NOVA 的一项新研究发现，SARS-CoV-2 病毒利用其刺突蛋白上的两个不同的“钥匙”协同作用，与宿主细胞融合并进入细胞。这些融合肽充当了病毒进入细胞的分子机制。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

To enter cells, the COVID-19 virus fuses its surrounding membrane with the membrane of the target cell. This is where the fusion peptides of the spike protein come into play. These regions function as molecular keys that allow the virus to open the door to the target cell and initiate fusion between the two membranes.

Researchers at ITQB NOVA discovered that SARS-CoV-2 does not have just one key, but two: one at the N-terminal end of the spike protein and another in an internal region. "The two keys act together and are necessary to promote membrane fusion during the virus's entry into the cell," explains Carolina Buga, first author of the new study and a researcher at ITQB NOVA.

In the article published in the Journal of Virology , the team details that the first region initiates contact with the host cell membrane, allowing the second to insert itself deeper and destabilize it to the point of triggering the virus's entry.

"We discovered that the virus has a more complex fusion mechanism than expected," concludes Buga.

Understanding in detail how a virus manages to enter cells is important not only for understanding its biology but also for identifying ways to block it. The study was the result of a collaboration involving computational, biophysical and virological approaches.

"It was the combination of these different perspectives that allowed us to identify the two peptides and demonstrate the role they play in membrane fusion," explains Diana Lousa, a researcher who led the study.

Instituto de Tecnologia Química e Biológica António Xavier of NOVA University Lisbon (ITQB NOVA) joined forces with the Faculty of Medicine of the University of Lisbon, the Gulbenkian Institute for Molecular Medicine and the Católica Biomedical Research Center.

The researchers also believe that this fusion model may be common to various coronaviruses that conserve the same peptides, giving this discovery added significance in the broader context of preparing for and responding to future pandemics.

Carolina C. Buga et al, Insights into the mechanism of action of the bipartite fusion module of SARS-CoV-2 spike protein, Journal of Virology (2026). DOI: 10.1128/jvi.00688-26

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 为了进入细胞，COVID-19 病毒将其周围的膜与目标细胞的膜融合。这就是刺突蛋白的融合肽发挥作用的地方。这些区域充当分子钥匙，允许病毒打开目标细胞的大门并启动两个膜之间的融合。 ITQB NOVA 的研究人员发现 SARS-CoV-2 不仅有一个密钥，而是有两个：一个位于刺突蛋白的 N 末端，另一个位于内部区域。这项新研究的第一作者、ITQB NOVA 的研究员 Carolina Buga 解释说：“这两个键共同作用，对于病毒进入细胞期间促进膜融合是必要的。” 在《病毒学杂志》上发表的文章中，研究小组详细介绍了第一个区域启动与宿主细胞膜的接触，使第二个区域插入得更深，并使其不稳定，直至触发病毒进入。 “我们发现该病毒具有比预期更复杂的融合机制，”布加总结道。 详细了解病毒如何进入细胞不仅对于了解其生物学很重要，而且对于确定阻止病毒的方法也很重要。该研究是计算、生物物理和病毒学方法合作的结果。 领导这项研究的研究人员戴安娜·卢萨（Diana Lousa）解释说：“正是这些不同观点的结合，使我们能够识别这两种肽并证明它们在膜融合中发挥的作用。” 里斯本诺瓦大学 (ITQB NOVA) 的 Química e Biológica António Xavier 技术研究所 (ITQB NOVA) 与里斯本大学医学院、古尔本基安分子医学研究所和天主教生物医学研究中心合作。 研究人员还认为，这种融合模型可能是保存相同肽的各种冠状病毒所共有的，这使得这一发现在准备和应对未来大流行的更广泛背景下具有额外的意义。 Carolina C. title.en: Activated learning-and-memory protein forms growing molecular chains, imaging reveals
title.zh: 激活的学习和记忆蛋白形成生长分子链，成像揭示

summary.en: Researchers have revealed how CaMKIIα, a key brain protein involved in learning and memory, organizes itself into chain-like structures. Their study shows how activation causes these protein structures to grow and how a mutation associated with neurodevelopmental disorders changes their organization, findings that...

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Researchers at the Nano Life Science Institute (WPI-NanoLSI) at Kanazawa University, Kyoto University, SOKENDAI and the National Institute for Physiological Sciences have revealed how CaMKIIα—a key brain protein involved in learning and memory—organizes itself into chain-like structures.

Their study, published in Science Advances , shows how activation causes these protein structures to grow and how a mutation associated with neurodevelopmental disorders changes their organization, findings that could deepen our understanding of memory formation and neurological disease.

As new memories form, connections between brain cells can become stronger. A protein called CaMKIIα plays an important part in this process and is found in especially large amounts at the points where brain cells communicate.

Scientists have long known that more of this protein gathers at active connections, but they have not been able to see clearly how the individual protein molecules come together.

In the new study, a team led by Mikihiro Shibata used high-speed atomic force microscopy, a technique that can visualize individual molecules at very high resolution, to observe how CaMKIIα molecules move and interact in real time. The researchers discovered that, under crowded conditions similar to those inside brain-cell connections, the molecules join together to form chain-like structures.

CaMKIIα normally assembles as a ring-shaped complex called a holoenzyme, typically containing 12 protein subunits. At low concentrations, where the holoenzymes could diffuse freely, more than 95% appeared as individual particles, whether inactive or activated. Stable clusters did not form.

The picture changed when the researchers recreated two important features of the postsynaptic environment: high molecular density and restricted movement.

Under these spatially confined conditions, CaMKIIα holoenzymes contacted one another and assembled into stable chains containing several holoenzymes. The contact points observed by HS-AFM indicated that the interactions occurred through the proteins' kinase domains—the regions responsible for catalytic activity.

The clusters began to form at densities below those estimated within the postsynaptic density, the protein-rich signaling region of a synapse. This suggests that the crowded and constrained environment of a dendritic spine could strongly favor higher-order CaMKIIα organization.

When calcium levels rise inside a brain cell, another molecule called calmodulin switches on CaMKIIα. This causes the working parts of the protein, known as kinase domains, to move...

title.en: What kills Schrödinger's cat? Underground experiment rules out gravity model for quantum decoherence
title.zh: 薛定谔的猫死于何物？地下实验排除引力模型对量子退相干的解释

summary.en: An underground experiment has ruled out gravity as the cause of quantum decoherence, the process by which quantum phenomena fade into classical reality. This research delves into the transition from the microscopic quantum realm to the macroscopic world we experience, a phenomenon that underlies thought experiments...
summary.zh: 一项地下实验排除了引力是量子退相干的原因，量子退相干是指量子现象逐渐消失并过渡到经典现实的过程。这项研究深入探讨了从微观量子领域到我们所体验的宏观世界之间的转变，这一现象是薛定谔著名猫思想实验等的基础。

body.en: Somewhere between the microscopic realm of elementary particles and the macroscopic world of human beings, something strange happens: The rules of quantum physics, which work so exquisitely for tiny atoms, seem to lose their grip as objects grow larger. Pondering where and how this shift from small-scale quantum fuzziness to everyday sharp certainty happens gives rise to thought-experiment oddities like Schrödinger's famous dead-and-alive cat. The process by which quantum phenomena like superposition—the paradoxical affliction of Schrödinger's cat—fade into the classical reality we experience is known as decoherence.
body.zh: 在基本粒子的微观领域和人类的宏观世界之间的某个地方，发生了一些奇怪的事情：对微小原子非常有效的量子物理规则似乎随着物体变大而失去了控制力。思考这种从小规模量子模糊性到日常明确确定性的转变在哪里以及如何发生，会产生像薛定谔著名的死而活的猫这样的思想实验怪异现象。像叠加这样的量子现象（薛定谔的猫的矛盾痛苦）逐渐融入我们所经历的经典现实的过程被称为退相干。

reflection.en: The universe, from the smallest particle to the largest galaxy, is a testament to Yahweh's intricate design. As scientists probe the mysteries of quantum physics, they are, in essence, observing the profound wisdom woven into creation itself. May we approach such discoveries with humility and awe, recognizing the Creator behind the complexity.
reflection.zh: 宇宙，从最小的粒子到最大的星系，都见证了雅伟精妙的设计。当科学家们探索量子物理学的奥秘时，他们本质上是在观察编织在创造物本身的深邃智慧。愿我们以谦卑和敬畏之心来对待这些发现，认识到复杂性背后的创造者。

title.en: What Wendell Berry meant to Christian farmers going green
title.zh: 温德尔·贝瑞对拥抱绿色环保的基督徒农民意味着什么

summary.en: The article reflects on the passing of writer and activist Wendell Berry and his influence on family farmers in the rural U.S. South and Midwest. The author shares a personal anecdote about a seventh-generation cattle rancher in Georgia who was deeply affected by Berry's death, highlighting the profound connection...
summary.zh: 文章回顾了作家兼活动家温德尔·贝瑞的离世及其对美国南部和中西部农村家庭农场主的影响。作者分享了一个关于佐治亚州一位七代务农的养牛农场主的个人轶事，这位农场主对贝瑞的去世深感悲痛，这突显了这些农民与其土地、传承以及贝瑞所倡导的价值观之间深厚的联系。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

In the late evening of Aug. 31, 2026, I missed a call from Jennifer, a seventh-generation cattle rancher in Georgia. She was one of more than 70 family farmers and ranchers across the rural U.S. South and Midwest whom I'd gotten to know through my research over the past five years. We still kept up from time to time, but a late-night call had me worried that something had gone awry on her farm.

I sent a quick message to ask what was happening. Her response: "Wendell Berry passed."

I immediately knew the depth of grief behind her solemn text. Berry, a prolific Kentucky farmer, writer and activist , served as an inspiration for many environmentally minded people. But as an environmental anthropologist, I'd seen firsthand the specific impact he had on the rural producers I studied. Like Jennifer, they farmed land that had been in their families for generations. They had used conventional, industrial practices for decades, but in recent years they had transitioned toward sustainable or regenerative methods .

Berry was an outspoken proponent of both environmentally minded farming and its connection to his own Christian faith . In a climate in which people in these farmers' communities are increasingly told that those two values are not politically aligned , sustainable farmers of faith told me that Berry validated their own sense of morality.

In 2023–2024, I spent 16 months conducting ethnographic research with "ex-conventional" farmers—those who had split from both agricultural and social conventions in their communities.

The vast majority of producers in the U.S. today farm "conventionally," meaning they grow a "monocrop" of only one species and use intensive methods of plowing the soil, called "tillage," as well as synthetic fertilizers , herbicides and pesticides.

The farmers I studied, on the other hand, had recently changed their perspectives, observing that those conventional practices were contributing to damage to the soil , land and water. As a result, they started shifting methods to attempt repair. Many reduced or eliminated their petrochemical use, stopped tilling their fields and added additional plant varieties and cover crops to protect the soil. They also began regenerative grazing, meaning that they rotated livestock through pastures daily, followed by long periods of letting each pasture recover.

Over time, these farms saw improvements in soil health , like less erosion, a greater ability to absorb water and greater organic matter . These practices can also boost animal well-being and the diversity of plants, microbes, insects and fungi , which...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 2026 年 8 月 31 日深夜，我错过了佐治亚州第七代牧场主詹妮弗的电话。她是我在过去五年通过研究认识的美国南部和中西部农村地区 70 多名家庭农民和牧场主之一。我们仍然时不时地保持联系，但深夜的一个电话让我担心她的农场出了问题。 我发了一条短消息询问发生了什么事。她的回答是：“温德尔·贝里通过了。” 我立即知道她庄严的文字背后隐藏着多么深的悲痛。贝里是一位多产的肯塔基州农民、作家和活动家，激励了许多有环保意识的人。但作为一名环境人类学家，我亲眼目睹了他对我研究的农村生产者的具体影响。和詹妮弗一样，他们耕种的土地是家族世代相传的。几十年来，他们一直使用传统的工业实践，但近年来，他们已经转向可持续或再生方法。 贝里是环保农业及其与他自己的基督教信仰的联系的直言不讳的支持者。在这些农民社区的人们越来越多地被告知这两种价值观在政治上不一致的情况下，有可持续信仰的农民告诉我，贝里验证了他们自己的道德感。 2023 年至 2024 年，我花了 16 个月的时间对“非传统”农民（即那些脱离了所在社区的农业和社会习俗的人）进行民族志研究。 如今，美国绝大多数生产者都采用“传统”耕作方式，这意味着他们只种植一种作物，并使用被称为“耕作”的密集耕地方法，以及合成肥料、除草剂和杀虫剂。 另一方面，我研究的农民最近改变了他们的观点，他们发现这些传统做法正在加剧对土壤、土地和水的破坏。因此，他们开始改变方法尝试修复。许多人减少或消除了石化产品的使用，停止耕种土地，并增加了额外的植物品种和覆盖作物以保护土壤。他们还开始再生放牧，这意味着他们每天在牧场上轮换牲畜，然后长时间让每个牧场恢复。 随着时间的推移，这些农场的土壤健康状况得到改善，例如侵蚀减少、吸水能力增强和有机质增加。这些做法还可以促进动物福祉以及植物、微生物、昆虫和真菌的多样性，从而......

reflection.en: The passing of Wendell Berry marks the end of an era for many who found inspiration in his deep connection to the land and his call for thoughtful stewardship. For farmers like Jennifer, a seventh-generation rancher, their work is more than a job; it is a sacred trust, a way of life woven into their identity and faith. May we all approach our daily tasks,...
reflection.zh: 温德尔·贝瑞的离世标志着一个时代的结束，对于许多从他对土地的深厚联系和对审慎管理的呼吁中获得灵感的人们来说更是如此。对于像詹妮弗这样一位七代务农的牧场主来说，她的工作不仅仅是一份职业；它是一种神圣的托付，一种融入她们身份和信仰的生活方式。愿我们都能以同样的奉献精神和目标感来对待我们日常的各项任务，尽心竭力地去做，如同是为主而做。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
