title.zh: 朋克五十年回顾——摇滚叛逆者半个世纪后深情回忆肮脏与狂怒

summary.en: Glen Matlock, Viv Albertine, and Rat Scabies revisit the music, clothes, and disgusting spitting in a likable documentary marking half a century of British punk. As most of them ease into their eighth decade, the overlords of British punk rock get yet another celebratory run-out, gently reheating material that has...
summary.zh: 格伦·马特洛克、薇薇安·阿尔伯特和拉特·斯卡比斯在一档纪念英国朋克半个世纪的讨喜纪录片中重温了音乐、服装和令人作呕的吐痰行为。当他们中的大多数人步入八十岁之际，英国朋克摇滚的巨头们又迎来了一次庆祝性的演出，温和地重新演绎着这些年来耳熟能详但从未失去魅力的作品。作为一种几乎瞬间从引发小报恐慌的威胁转变为明信片式漫画的亚文...

body.en: Glen Matlock, Viv Albertine and Rat Scabies revisit the music, clothes and disgusting spitting in a likable documentary marking half a century of British punk As the majority of them ease into their eighth decade, the overlords of British punk rock get yet another celebratory runout, gently reheating material that has become familiar over the years but never loses its appeal. A subculture that passed almost immediately from tabloid-triggering menace to picture-postcard caricature, punk may have passed into legend as a joyless and even squalid diversion in music and fashion history, but its surviving spokespeople recall their participation in it all with no little enthusiasm, even if they’ve clearly said it a thousand times already. No doubt it is the gen alphas among us who will benefit most; you’d expect their jaws to drop and eyes to roll at some of the stuff deemed perfectly acceptable in the late 1970s: women’s-breasts T-shirts, amateurish pancake makeup, and all that disgusting spitting. (“I didn’t mind it going in my mouth,” says the Damned’s Captain Sensible at one point, out-disgusting everyone.) There’s a good spread of voices on offer; at least one member of most of the era’s big acts puts in an appearance with Glen Matlock (the Sex Pistols), Rat Scabies (the Damned), Terry Chimes (the Clash), Steve Severin (Siouxsie and the Banshees), and Hugh Cornwell (the Stranglers) leading the way. (The latter, though affable enough, is easily the least impressed as to punk’s actual achievements, which is a valuable corrective.) The original punk wave had little space for women (despite the sense that blows were being struck for equality) and that’s the case in the film as well: Gaye Advert (the Adverts) and Viv Albertine (the Slits) get a bit of time on camera though inevitably get a bit lost in it all. Due recognition, however, is paid to designer Vivienne Westwood as punk’s true founding spirit; Sex, the King’s Road boutique she ran with Malcolm McLaren, was a crucible of the British punk scene. Don Boyd, who produced the Pistols’ movie The Great Rock ‘n’ Roll Swindle along with the late Jeremy Thomas, says she “was punk and is punk … it came from her”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 格伦·马特洛克 (Glen Matlock)、维夫·艾伯丁 (Viv Albertine) 和拉特·斯卡比斯 (Rat Scabies) 在这部记录英国朋克半个世纪的可爱纪录片中重新审视了音乐、服装和令人作呕的口水。随着他们中的大多数人步入八十岁，英国朋克摇滚的霸主们又迎来了一次庆祝性的结束，轻轻地重新加热多年来已经熟悉但从未失去吸引力的材料。作为一种亚文化，朋克几乎立即从小报引发的威胁转变为明信片上的漫画，朋克可能已经成为音乐和时尚史上无趣甚至肮脏的消遣的传奇，但它幸存的代言人以不小的热情回忆起他们参与的这一切，即使他们已经明确说过一千遍了。毫无疑问，我们中的阿尔法一代将受益最多。你可能会期望他们对 20 世纪 70 年代末被认为完全可以接受的一些东西感到惊讶不已：女性胸部 T 恤、业余的煎饼化妆品，以及所有令人恶心的吐口水。 （“我不介意它进入我的嘴里，”该死的船长理智有一次说道，这让所有人都感到恶心。）这个时代大多数大型演出中至少有一名成员登场，格伦·马特洛克（性手枪乐队）、拉特·斯卡比斯（诅咒乐队）、特里·奇姆斯（冲突乐队）、史蒂夫·塞维林（苏西与女妖乐队）和休·康威尔（绞杀者乐队）领衔。 （后者虽然很和蔼可亲，但对朋克的实际成就印象最差，这是一个有价值的纠正。）最初的朋克浪潮几乎没有给女性留下空间（尽管人们感觉为了平等而受到​​打击），电影中也是如此：Gaye Advert（《广告》）和 Viv Albertine（《狭缝》）在镜头前花了一点时间，但不可避免地会有点迷失其中。然而，设计师薇薇安·韦斯特伍德 (Vivienne Westwood) 却得到了应有的认可，认为她是朋克真正的奠基精神。她与马尔科姆·麦克拉伦 (Malcolm McLaren) 共同经营的国王路精品店 Sex 是英国朋克界的严酷考验。与已故的杰里米·托马斯一起制作手枪乐队电影《摇滚大骗局》的唐·博伊德说，她“曾经是朋克，现在就是朋克……这一切都来自于她”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary looks back at the punk rock scene 50 years on, with its surviving artists fondly recalling the music, fashion, and rebellious spirit. Even as they reflect on a past marked by 'filth and fury,' their continued enthusiasm for their creative work speaks to a dedication that transcends time. It reminds us that whatever our calling, whether it's...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片回顾了五十年前的朋克摇滚景象，其幸存的艺术家们深情回忆着当时的音乐、时尚和叛逆精神。即使在回顾那个充满“肮脏与狂怒”的过去时，他们对创作工作的持续热情也体现了一种超越时间的奉献精神。它提醒我们，无论我们的使命是什么，无论是创作音乐还是其他任何事情，我们都被鼓励全心投入，好像是为雅伟本人工作一样。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: ‘When you tell people the story, it’s almost too good to be true’: the incredible journey behind The Cycle of Love
title.zh: 《爱之循环》背后的不可思议之旅：当你告诉人们这个故事，它几乎好得令人难以置信

summary.en: Documentary director Orlando von Einsiedel discusses the true story of a man who cycled 6,000 miles from India to Sweden in search of his true love, a tale that promises to warm hearts. The story begins in New Delhi in December 1975 when Swedish hippie Lotta von Schedvin met Indian street artist Pradyumna Kumar...
summary.zh: 纪录片导演奥兰多·冯·艾因西德尔讲述了一个真实故事：一位男子骑行了6000英里，从印度到瑞典寻找他的真爱，这个故事足以温暖人心。故事始于1975年12月的德里，瑞典嬉皮士洛塔·冯·谢德文遇见了印度街头艺术家普拉迪尤姆纳·库马尔·马哈南迪亚（PK）。两人一见钟情，迅速坠入爱河，PK陪同洛塔回到了他在印度的村庄。然而，不久...

body.en: Documentary director Orlando von Einsiedel on how the real life tale of a man who cycles 6,000 miles from India to Sweden to find his true love will warm your heart New Delhi, December 1975. It was love at first sight when a Swedish hippy called Lotta von Schedvin sat down to be sketched by an Indian street artist, Pradyumna Kumar Mahanandia, known to everyone as PK. In the 10 minutes it took PK to complete her portrait, everything clicked into place for the pair. They were swept headlong in a whirlwind romance, and PK took Lotta to his village in the east of India to meet his family. But soon after, the time came for Lotta to pack up her VW campervan and head back home with her friends. Heart-stricken PK promised to follow, but a plane ticket to Sweden was an impossible dream. Determined not to lose the love of his life, PK bought a secondhand Raleigh bike, and with $80 sewn into the waistband of his trousers, set off to cycle 6,000 miles to Lotta . He knew the sun set in the west, so that was the direction he took. His plan was to follow the hippy trail, cycling through India, Pakistan, Afghanistan, Iran and Turkey, crossing Europe, finally arriving in Sweden. Continue reading...
body.zh: 1975 年 12 月，新德里，纪录片导演奥兰多·冯·艾因西德尔 (Orlando von Einsiedel) 讲述了一个男人骑车 6,000 英里从印度到瑞典寻找真爱的真实故事如何温暖你的心。当瑞典嬉皮士洛塔·冯·谢德文 (Lotta von Schedvin) 坐下来接受印度街头艺术家普拉杜姆纳·库马尔·马哈南迪亚 (Pradyumna Kumar Mahanandia)（大家都称为 PK）的素描时，他一见钟情。 PK 花了 10 分钟完成了她的肖像画，两人的一切都顺利完成。他们被旋风般的浪漫所席卷，PK带着洛塔到印度东部的村庄去见他的家人。但不久之后，洛塔就收拾好她的大众露营车，和朋友们一起回家了。伤心欲绝的PK答应了，但一张飞往瑞典的机票却是一个遥不可及的梦想。 PK 决心不失去一生挚爱，他买了一辆二手罗利自行车，并用 80 美元缝在裤腰带上，出发骑车 6,000 英里前往洛塔。他知道太阳已经西下，所以他就朝西边走。他的计划是沿着嬉皮士路线，骑自行车穿过印度、巴基斯坦、阿富汗、伊朗和土耳其，穿越欧洲，最后到达瑞典。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The incredible journey of Pradyumna Kumar Mahanandia, cycling thousands of miles for love, echoes the profound commitment described in Genesis. This story reminds us that true love can inspire extraordinary devotion and a willingness to bridge vast distances for union. This journey, spanning 6,000 miles from India to Sweden, speaks to a deep human longing...
reflection.zh: 普拉迪尤姆纳·库马尔·马哈南迪亚为爱骑行数千英里的非凡旅程，呼应了《创世记》中所描述的深刻承诺。这个故事提醒我们，真爱能够激发非凡的奉献精神，以及为结合而跨越遥远距离的意愿。 这场跨越印度到瑞典6000英里的旅程，体现了人类对连接的深切渴望，以及一个人可能为了珍贵的关系而付出的努力。它彰显了爱的强大力量，能够激励个人承担起艰巨的任务。

verse.textEn: That is why a man leaves his father and mother and is united to his wife, and they become one flesh.
verse.textZh: 因此，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。

title.en: The Watergate Caper: Richard Nixon and the Death of the American Dream review – political scandal, 70s style
title.zh: 水门事件：理查德·尼克松与美国梦之死评论——70年代风格的政治丑闻

summary.en: Shane O’Sullivan’s documentary weaves archive clips and snippets from films old and new to draw out the highlights of the crisis that rocked the US. Judging by his past work, the Irish-born, London-based writer and film-maker Shane O’Sullivan may have a chronic case of...
summary.zh: 沙恩·奥沙利文的纪录片通过剪辑旧电影和新电影的片段，回顾了那场震动美国的危机的亮点。从他过去的作品来看，这位出生于爱尔兰、现居伦敦的作家兼电影制作人沙恩·奥沙利文可能患有……

body.en: Shane O’Sullivan’s documentary weaves archive clips and snippets from films old and new to draw out the highlights of the crisis that rocked the US Judging by his past work, the Irish-born, London-based writer and film-maker Shane O’Sullivan may have a chronic case of born-too-late nostalgia. It manifests as a fascination with the politics and counterculture of the late 1960s and 70s, and that’s clearly a theme in O’Sullivan’s previous works, which include: a book and film about the assassination of Robert Kennedy; the acclaimed feature doc Children of the Revolution about the female leaders of the Baader-Meinhof Group and the Japanese Red Army; and a film about Lee Harvey Oswald . His latest takes aim at the big kahuna itself: Watergate – the crime, the scandal and the cultural phenomenon. It is explored through a hailstorm of archive clips and snippets of feature films, all nimbly stitched together, with a deadpan voiceover by the great Harry Shearer. The result is, of course, nostalgic, but also feels fresh and immediate, especially thanks to the use of moments from more recent features about, but not from, the period, including a Watergate-hearings-obsessed teenage Christina Ricci in The Ice Storm from 1997, the comic ineptitude of the Watergate burglars as represented in 1999 spoof Dick, or Shea Whigham’s skewering of break-in mastermind G Gordon Liddy from recent TV miniseries Gaslit. These performed moments all play nicely with O’Sullivan’s selection of clips from more contemporaneous, Watergate-adjacent classics such as Medium Cool, All the President’s Men and Taxi Driver. Continue reading...
body.zh: 肖恩·奥沙利文 (Shane O’Sullivan) 的纪录片将新旧电影中的档案片段和片段编织在一起，勾勒出这场震撼美国的危机的亮点。从爱尔兰出生、现居伦敦的作家兼电影制片人肖恩·奥沙利文 (Shane O’Sullivan) 过去的作品来看，他可能患有一种长期的、生来太晚的怀旧情绪。它表现为对 20 世纪 60 年代末和 70 年代政治和反主流文化的迷恋，这显然是奥沙利文之前作品的主题，其中包括：一本关于罗伯特·肯尼迪遇刺的书籍和电影；广受好评的专题纪录片《革命之子》讲述了巴德尔-迈因霍夫集团​​和日本红军的女性领导人；以及一部关于李·哈维·奥斯瓦尔德的电影。他的最新作品瞄准了大魔王本身：水门事件——犯罪、丑闻和文化现象。通过大量的档案剪辑和故事片片段来探索它，所有这些都灵活地缝合在一起，并由伟大的哈利·希勒（Harry Shearer）面无表情的画外音。当然，其结果是怀旧的，但也让人感觉新鲜和直接，特别是得益于使用了有关这一时期的最新电影中的片段，包括 1997 年《冰风暴》中沉迷于水门事件听证会的青少年克里斯蒂娜·里奇，1999 年恶搞迪克所代表的水门窃贼的滑稽无能，或者谢伊·惠格姆对入室盗窃的串烧最近电视迷你剧《煤气灯火》中的策划者 G Gordon Liddy。这些表演时刻都与奥沙利文从更多同时代的、与水门事件相关的经典作品中精选的片段（例如《Medium Cool》、《总统班底》和《出租车司机》）完美契合。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Shane O’Sullivan’s documentary revisits the Watergate scandal, a moment when trust in American leadership was profoundly shaken. The crisis serves as a stark reminder that national integrity is not merely a political ideal but a foundational element of a nation's character and stability. When leaders betray public trust, the very fabric of the nation's...
reflection.zh: 沙恩·奥沙利文的纪录片重温了水门事件，那是一个美国领导层信任受到严重动摇的时刻。这场危机鲜明地提醒我们，国家的正直不仅仅是一个政治理想，更是国家品格和稳定的基石。当领导人辜负公众信任时，国家梦想的根基就会受到威胁。

verse.textEn: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin condemns any people.
verse.textZh: 公义使邦国高举；罪恶是人民的羞辱。

title.en: Ex-BBC presenter questions role of Royal Family in new documentary
title.zh: 新纪录片中前BBC主持人质疑王室的作用

summary.en: Veteran broadcaster John Humphrys has released a new documentary, 'The Royals: Time to Go?', exploring the role of the Royal Family and arguing that the UK public should have the right to choose their leaders. The film features discussions with both critics and supporters of the monarchy.
summary.zh: 资深广播人约翰·汉弗莱斯推出了一部新纪录片《王室：是时候离开了？》，探讨了王室的作用，并主张英国公众应该有权选择自己的领导人。该片采访了君主制的批评者和支持者。

body.en:
Veteran broadcaster John Humphrys has said the people of the United Kingdom should "be able to choose our leaders" as he releases a documentary exploring the role of the Royal Family.

Humphrys, who for decades was one of the most prominent faces on the BBC, is presenting a new Channel 4 documentary called The Royals: Time to Go?

Speaking to BBC Radio Wales Breakfast , the Cardiff-born presenter said he "admires" King Charles III in many ways, but said it was a "matter of choice".

In the documentary, Humphrys speaks to both critics and supporters of the monarchy, and makes the case for electing a president as the head of state.

He recalled seeing the late Queen Elizabeth II visiting Cardiff when he was growing up, watching her being driven down Newport Road.

"My father didn't attend and said he would never bend the knee to anyone. I guess that rubbed off on me," he said.

Humphrys asked why it was seen as such a taboo to call for an alternative to the Royal Family, saying that "we can because it's a democracy".

"I know the monarch is not a political leader, but he is our leader, and we need to bow our knee to him.

He met the Queen throughout his career, including at Buckingham Palace where he said he spoke to her "and the corgis of course".

Humphrys, who presented the Nine O'Clock News, the Today programme and Mastermind throughout a decades-long career with the corporation, said he took the opportunity to ask her for an interview.

"When I'd finished, she looked up at me and said just one word 'no' and I thought I could build on that," he said.
body.zh: 资深广播员约翰·汉弗莱斯在发布一部探索王室角色的纪录片时表示，英国人民应该“能够选择我们的领导人”。 几十年来，汉弗莱斯一直是 BBC 最著名的面孔之一，他正在制作第四频道的一部新纪录片，名为《皇家队：该出发了？》 这位出生于卡迪夫的主持人在接受英国广播公司威尔士广播电台早餐节目采访时表示，他在很多方面“钦佩”国王查理三世，但表示这是一个“选择的问题”。 在纪录片中，汉弗莱斯与君主制的批评者和支持者进行了交谈，并阐述了选举总统作为国家元首的理由。 他回忆起在他长大的时候看到已故女王伊丽莎白三世访问卡迪夫，看着她被开车沿着纽波特路行驶。 “我父亲没有出席，他说他永远不会向任何人屈服。我想这对我产生了影响，”他说。 汉弗莱斯问为什么呼吁替代王室被视为禁忌，他说“我们可以，因为这是民主国家”。 “我知道君主不是政治领袖，但他是我们的领袖，我们需要向他屈服。 他在整个职业生涯中都见过女王，包括在白金汉宫，他说他在那里与她“当然还有柯基犬”交谈过。 汉弗莱斯在该公司长达数十年的职业生涯中一直主持《九点钟新闻》、《今日节目》和《Mastermind》，他说他借此机会邀请她接受采访。 “当我说完后，她抬头看着我，只说了一个字‘不’，我想我可以在此基础上再接再厉，”他说。

reflection.en: John Humphrys' documentary prompts a timely question about the nature of leadership and the right of citizens to choose their heads of state. Jeremiah 22:3 calls rulers to 'execute justice and righteousness, and deliver from the oppressor him who suffers violence.' This verse reminds us that leadership, whether inherited or elected, carries a profound...
reflection.zh: 约翰·汉弗莱斯的纪录片提出了一个关于领导力本质和公民选择国家元首权利的及时问题。《耶利米书》22章3节呼吁统治者“施行公平和公义，拯救被欺压的脱离欺压者的手”。这节经文提醒我们，无论是世袭还是民选的领导，都肩负着公正服务人民的重大责任。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Battle of Chile director Patricio Guzmán dies aged 85
title.zh: 智利电影导演帕特里西奥·古兹曼去世，享年85岁

summary.en: Patricio Guzmán, a filmmaker celebrated for his unflinching yet poetic documentaries that explored the impact of the Pinochet regime in Chile and its subsequent social and political turmoil, has died at the age of 85. He passed away in Paris following cardiorespiratory arrest. Guzmán's work consistently focused on the...
summary.zh: 帕特里西奥·古兹曼（Patricio Guzmán）是一位电影制作人，他以其毫不留情却又富有诗意的纪录片而闻名国际，这些影片探讨了皮诺切特政权在智利及其后续社会政治动荡的影响。他于周二在巴黎因心肺骤停去世，享年85岁。古兹曼的职业生涯主要关注1973年奥古斯托·皮诺切特政变对萨尔瓦多·阿连德总统及其民选政府造成的破坏。

body.en: Passionate documentary maker won international acclaim for unsparing but poetic films exploring the impact of the Pinochet regime in Chile Patricio Guzmán, the film-maker who chronicled Chile’s bloody 1970s political strife and its subsequent social and political turmoil in films such as The Battle of Chile and Nostalgia for the Light, has died aged 85. According to Chilean news outlet Emol , Guzmán died on Tuesday in Paris after a cardiorespiratory arrest. Guzmán’s chief preoccupation throughout his career was the carnage unleashed by Augusto Pinochet’s coup in 1973 against Salvador Allende, Chile’s elected president. He later told the Guardian : “I’m a film-maker who was very marked by the ways of the dictator. It has remained with me for ever. I cannot leave it behind.” However, he resisted the idea that he was an activist, political film-maker, adding: “I’m not a sociologist. Neither am I a politician. I make films that are metaphorical and poetic; I interpret reality through my own personal way of looking.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 帕特里西奥·古兹曼是一位充满激情的纪录片制作人，他以毫不留情但富有诗意的电影探讨了皮诺切特政权对智利的影响，赢得了国际赞誉。帕特里西奥·古兹曼曾在《智利之战》和《怀念光明》等影片中记录了智利 1970 年代血腥的政治冲突以及随后的社会和政治动乱，现已去世，享年 85 岁。据智利新闻媒体《Emol》报道，古兹曼于周二在巴黎因心肺衰竭去世。逮捕。古兹曼整个职业生涯的主要关注点是 1973 年奥古斯托·皮诺切特 (Augusto Pinochet) 针对智利民选总统萨尔瓦多·阿连德 (Salvador Allende) 发起的政变所引发的屠杀。他后来告诉《卫报》：“我是一名电影制作人，对独裁者的行事方式有着深刻的印象。它永远伴随着我。我不能把它抛在身后。”然而，他拒绝承认自己是一名激进分子、政治电影制片人，并补充道：“我不是社会学家。我也不是政治家。我制作的电影具有隐喻性和诗意；我通过自己个人的观看方式来解释现实。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: For decades, Patricio Guzmán bore witness to the deep wounds inflicted by political violence in Chile, chronicling the suffering and turmoil with unflinching honesty. His films, like 'The Battle of Chile,' served as a powerful testament to the human cost of oppression and upheaval. Through his work, he sought to bring understanding and perhaps a measure of...
reflection.zh: 数十年来，帕特里西奥·古兹曼见证了智利政治暴力造成的深刻创伤，并以毫不动摇的诚实记录了苦难和动荡。《智利之战》等影片有力地证明了压迫和动荡对人类造成的代价。通过他的作品，他试图为仍在努力应对过去创伤的国家带来理解，或许还有一丝治愈，这呼应了神治愈心碎之人的应许。

verse.textEn: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
verse.textZh: 他医好伤心的人，裹好他们的伤处。

title.en: Israeli minister threatens to strip Israeli film-makers of citizenship over Gaza documentary NAZA
title.zh: 以色列部长威胁取消加沙纪录片制作人的公民身份

summary.en: Israel's culture minister, Miki Zohar, has called for the citizenship of Oscar-winning directors Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor to be revoked. He accused them of "treason against the state" for their documentary 'NAZA,' which exposes the Israeli intelligence service's acronym for expected civilian casualties in Gaza...
summary.zh: 以色列文化部长米基·佐哈尔呼吁取消奥斯卡获奖导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕和蕾切尔·索尔的公民身份。他指责他们制作的纪录片《NAZA》犯有“叛国罪”，该片揭露了以色列情报部门用于表示加沙空袭中预期平民伤亡的缩略语。这部电影强调了以色列军事行动对平民造成的毁灭性影响。

body.en: Miki Zohar accuses Oscar-winning directors Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor of ‘treason against the state’ ‘They know the house they are bombing is full of children’: NAZA’s directors on their devastating film about Israeli intelligence Israel’s culture minister has called for the Oscar-winning Israeli directors of NAZA , a documentary about the country’s mass killing of civilians in Gaza, to be stripped of their citizenship, accusing them of “treason against the state”. NAZA, which was produced by the Guardian, is named for an acronym used by Israel’s intelligence service to indicate how many civilians it expects to die in an airstrike on Gaza. Continue reading...
body.zh: 米基·佐哈尔指责奥斯卡获奖导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕和雷切尔·索尔“背叛国家”“他们知道他们轰炸的房子里都是孩子”：NAZA 的导演在拍摄有关以色列情报的毁灭性电影时以色列文化部长呼吁剥夺奥斯卡获奖导演 NAZA 的以色列国籍，这是一部关于该国在加沙大规模屠杀平民的纪录片，指责他们“背叛国家”。 NAZA 由《卫报》制作，以以色列情报部门使用的缩写词命名，用于表示预计在加沙空袭中将有多少平民死亡。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The story presents a stark conflict between artistic expression and state power. When a government official threatens to revoke citizenship for a film that documents civilian suffering, it raises questions about accountability and the role of art in confronting difficult truths. Jeremiah 22:3 calls leaders to "execute justice and righteousness" and protect...
reflection.zh: 这个故事呈现了艺术表达与国家权力之间尖锐的冲突。当一位政府官员威胁要取消一部记录平民苦难的电影制作人的公民身份时，就引发了关于问责制和艺术在面对艰难真相中的作用的问题。耶利米书 22:3 呼吁领导人“施行公平和公义”，保护弱者，这是一个可以衡量此类行为的标准。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Musk review – epic study of the world’s richest and most banal man
title.zh: 马斯克评论——关于世界上最富有但又最平庸的男人的史诗研究

summary.en: Venice Film Festival: Alex Gibney's absorbing documentary, 'Elon is a Nuke,' interviews former colleagues, wives, the trillionaire's father, and even a CG avatar. Ashley St Clair, a former conservative influencer and Musk's ex-girlfriend, is featured as an 'expert witness' in this four-hour study of the South...
summary.zh: 威尼斯电影节：亚历克斯·吉布尼的引人入胜的纪录片《埃隆是一枚核弹》采访了前同事、妻子、这位万亿富翁的父亲，甚至还有一个电脑生成化身。阿什莉·圣克莱尔（Ashley St...

body.en: Venice film festival: Alex Gibney interviews former colleagues, wives, the trillionaire’s father and a CG avatar in this absorbing documentary ‘Elon is a nuke.” The speaker is Ashley St Clair, a former conservative Maga influencer and one of Elon Musk’s former girlfriends-slash-baby mommas. She is a fascinating expert witness in Alex Gibney’s four-hour epic study of the world’s richest and dullest man: the overgrown brattish South-African-born trillionaire plutocrat, ersatz visionary and Trump courtier who owns Tesla cars, SpaceX rocket ships, Starlink satellites on which nation states’ military capabilities are increasingly reliant, X (formerly Twitter) which shapes the collective incel id of billions and GrokAI whose vast server farms daily guzzle oceans of precious water. Continue reading...
body.zh: 威尼斯电影节：亚历克斯·吉布尼在这部引人入胜的纪录片《埃隆是核武器》中采访了他的前同事、妻子、亿万富翁的父亲和 CG 头像。演讲者是阿什利·圣克莱尔 (Ashley St Clair)，她是一位前保守派 Maga 影响者，也是埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的前女友、斜线婴儿妈妈之一。在亚历克斯·吉布尼（Alex Gibney）对世界上最富有和最愚钝的人的长达四个小时的史诗般的研究中，她是一位引人入胜的专家证人：出生于南非的亿万富翁，是一个过于自大、脾气暴躁的亿万富豪、冒牌的梦想家和特朗普的朝臣，拥有特斯拉汽车、SpaceX火箭飞船、民族国家军事能力越来越依赖的星链卫星、塑造了数十亿集体非自愿群体的X（以前的推特）和每天都有庞大服务器群的GrokAI吞噬海洋宝贵的水资源。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary probes the immense power and influence of Elon Musk, a figure who wields vast technological control. The narrative describes him as an 'ersatz visionary,' suggesting a disconnect between his ambition and true wisdom. This echoes the ancient story of Babel, where human ambition and technological prowess sought to reach the heavens,...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片深入探讨了埃隆·马斯克——这位拥有巨大技术控制权的人物——的巨大权力和影响力。叙述将他描述为一位“伪造的远见者”，暗示了他的野心与真正的智慧之间存在脱节。这让人联想到古代巴别塔的故事，当时人类的野心和技术实力试图触及天堂，最终导致了混乱和分裂。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Mourinho review – if he didn’t want to open up, maybe he shouldn’t have starred in a docuseries …
title.zh: 穆里尼奥影评——如果他不想敞开心扉，也许他就不该出演纪录片……

summary.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film,
summary.zh: 足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥主演了一部三集纪录片，由《兄弟：尖叫停止后》的创作者制作。别指望它会那么有趣……这部迷你剧的导演乔·珀尔曼之前的作品包括2018年那部揭露性十足又滑稽的电影，

body.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film, Bros: After the Screaming Stops . That documentary worked brilliantly because its subjects seemed so sweetly but devastatingly lacking in discretion or self-awareness that everything they said landed like a line from a Christopher Guest parody. They couldn’t help themselves. In terms of a character study, storied football manager José Mourinho is a very different kettle of cold fish. Like the Goss twins, he takes himself very seriously indeed, but that’s pretty much where the similarities end. He’s something of a closed book. “You are pushing me to speak about myself,” he says, towards the end of the final part of this series. “And I don’t want to.” Which is fair enough but it does beg the question: why then, would you agree to be the subject of an in-depth three part documentary series? Mourinho is on Netflix Continue reading...
body.zh: 足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥在《兄弟：尖叫停止之后》创作者制作的三部曲中担任主演。别指望它会这么有趣……在这部迷你剧的导演乔·皮尔曼 (Joe Pearlman) 之前的作品中，可以数 2018 年的一部具有启发性和搞笑性的电影《兄弟：尖叫停止后》。这部纪录片取得了出色的效果，因为它的主题看起来如此甜蜜，但严重缺乏判断力或自我意识，以至于他们所说的一切都像克里斯托弗·盖斯特（Christopher Guest）戏仿中的台词一样。他们无法自拔。就性格研究而言，传奇足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥是一个非常不同的冷鱼。和戈斯双胞胎一样，他确实非常认真地对待自己，但相似之处也仅此而已。他就像一本合上的书。 “你迫使我谈论我自己，”他在本系列最后一部分的结尾说道。 “而我不想。”这很公平，但它确实引出了一个问题：那么，为什么你会同意成为一个深入的三部分纪录片系列的主题呢？穆里尼奥在 Netflix 上继续阅读...

reflection.en: José Mourinho's documentary is critiqued for his unwillingness to truly open up, despite the public platform it offers. This reminds us that fame and public attention, like a refiner's fire, test a person's true character, revealing what lies beneath the surface. When given a stage, our authenticity is often put to the test, showing whether we are willing...
reflection.zh: 穆里尼奥的纪录片因他不愿真正敞开心扉而受到批评，尽管它提供了一个公共平台。这提醒我们，名声和公众关注，如同炼金的炉火，考验着一个人的真实品格，揭示其表象之下的本质。当我们被赋予一个舞台时，我们的真诚往往会受到考验，展现我们是否愿意被真实地了解。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。
